title: Inhibition function
paragraphs: From that point on, we were able to bring the situation under control quickly. After all, Siltvelt is a country with many people from tribes known for their combat prowess. There are countless skilled fighters there.

However, it seems to be a fact that even those skilled fighters were being pushed back quite a bit. Once we’d managed to quell the unrest in the town below the castle, everyone—with exhaustion clearly visible on their faces—set about assessing the situation.

Incidentally, the damage to the castle itself was minor. Apparently, not only were the Filolial-sama I had originally deployed participating in the defense, but the situation was also handled by those who had undergone the “Four Representative Classes” or “Class Up” upgrades.
To assess the damage, I’ll head inside the castle with Father and the others to inquire about the situation.

Given the circumstances, representatives from Siltvelt have also gathered here. Since many of the generals view battle as their greatest honor, I’m told the suppression of the distorted Filolial-sama is progressing. The problem is… they say casualties among the Filolial-sama running amok in battles against anyone other than the elite fighters like Yuki-chan and Éclair are unavoidable.
Ugh… It’s like sitting on a bed of nails. How did things come to this…? I’m so restless I could burst, but Father is holding me back, so I can’t move.
“It’s only because this was our base that the damage was so minor…”
“However, the Filolials are a gentle race. I find it hard to believe that wild Filolials would have gone berserk.”

At that point, the representative of the Shusaku Beastman race—who had transformed into a Beastman form for combat—and the elder of the Genmu race spoke up. It seems even the four representative species, which I don’t recall specifically training, were able to hold their own to some extent.
“To be honest, these Filolials likely have a level of at least 100, at the very least. They’re moving with that much agility and launching powerful attacks.”

“It seems the captured Filolials also have monster marks engraved on their bodies. If anyone other than the Heroes’ Filolials attempts to restrain them for investigation, they self-destruct, killing themselves and the Filolials along with them to destroy the evidence…”
“What?! What did you say?!”

So does that mean if anyone other than Yuki-chan and the others captures Filolial-sama to examine it, it will die!? Then I have to stop this even more than before… No, if I stop it, what will happen to Filolial-sama!? Ugh… My head feels like it’s about to start smoking.
“Motoyasu, pull yourself together!　Um, please try as much as possible to keep anything too upsetting out of Motoyasu-kun’s ears.”
“O-okay.”

“However… while the damage to the castle and the town is gradually subsiding, given that similar disturbances are occurring all over the world… we’ve decided it would be best to ask the Heroes for their advice on what to do.”
The old man of the Genmu clan is asking us. …I’d been trying not to think about it, but apparently, Filolial-sama is running amok all over the world. W-why has it come to this…?
“Anyway, we’ve managed to capture it and are investigating it, right? What’s going on?”

“Well… it seems that when we had someone in Siltvelt who’s knowledgeable about Filolials examine it, they determined it’s a strange Filolial that has developed differently from both the ones raised by the Heroes and ordinary Filolials… As for its owner, we know they exist, but the analysis itself isn’t complete yet.”
“Hey, Naofumi,”
Sakura-chan asks Father with a worried look on her face.
“What is it?”
“Are Mel-chan and the others okay? I’m worried, Sakura…”
“This is happening all over the world. Is everything okay in Melromarc?”
“The global information network is quite chaotic… no, communications have been severely disrupted, so I can’t say for certain, but probably…”
“Ugh… I think we should hurry over there to check…”
The Filolial-sama are running amok all over the world. What on earth should we do…?
“It’s crystal clear to anyone that there’s definitely a mastermind behind this.”
Rival, who had just returned, said.
“There’s no doubt that someone with malicious intent toward the Filolial-sama is involved.”
Rival looked at me and continued. Someone with malicious intent, you say?
“Even from Gaelion’s perspective, those Filolials are distorted… far too strange. They wouldn’t end up like that unless they’d undergone some kind of biological modification.”
“Come to think of it, I heard there was a report that one of Rat-san’s rivals had infiltrated the remnants of Takt and went missing…”

“Ah, that’s right. I think it’s highly likely. If they figured out a way to break through the limits and perform a Class Up using the stolen Dragon Emperor’s Shard, and then performed some strange biological modifications on the Filolials, it’s entirely possible…”

“Come to think of it, didn’t you say that when Motoyasu-kun went on a buying trip, the Filolial Ranch was attacked and left in ruins? Plus, there were reports of Filolials being in short supply all over the world, so maybe…”
“I see… So they just brushed it off as being caused by the Filolial-sama’s popularity as Idols.”

…Are you telling me all these things are connected right here? In other words, the remnants of the Takt faction started gathering Filolial eggs from all over the world and pulling stunts like this just to harass me?
What kind of people are they?! Their personalities are twisted beyond belief!
“But why target the Filolials…”
“Honestly, even I think this crosses a line that Gaelion shouldn’t cross… Even if it’s just harassment against the Spear Hero, once it goes too far, there’s nothing we can do about it.”
“No doubt about it… Even in Zeltoble, where there are plenty of Guilds of Darkness and Merchants of Death, people would think that’s a line they shouldn’t cross.”
“I don’t think this will end here… I think they’re trying to eliminate us by any means necessary…”
Ugh… Those Takt remnants! They’re the kind of people who come up with nothing but underhanded tricks!
“Their goal is undoubtedly to discredit the Filolials, target the Spear Hero… and ultimately spread the idea that Naofumi and the others are to blame.”

“I suppose so… Mysterious Filolials are causing massive damage all over the world, even in small towns and villages. It seems the Filolials raised by the Shield Heroes and Spear Heroes develop differently from ordinary Filolials. The story goes that these mysterious Filolials are the very ones the Heroes used to seize control of the world—and that they’ve now turned against them by becoming Demon Lords.”
Ugh… That’s exactly the kind of ploy those conspiracy theorists would come up with. I suppose Father’s deduction is spot on.

“If we were to defeat Naofumi and the Spear Hero here through some sort of strategy, and then all the Filolials across the world were to stop moving in a chain reaction and die… what do you think people would think?”
"That sounds about right. As a result, the Filolials became a people despised as servants of the Demon King, were driven out, and went extinct… That matches what Motoyasu-kun told me."
Hearing Father talk about Rival makes a seething rage well up from the very depths of my gut.

“How should I put it… this act of staging a grand presentation just to disparage the other party… it reminds me of that so-called ‘King of Inventors.’ You could say it’s a tactic truly befitting the remnants of Takt.”
Such barbaric acts! This is absolutely unforgivable!
“I will absolutely not forgive them! Those vermin, those pigs! I’ll torture them to death, bit by bit!”

I’ll torture them to death bit by bit… and while offering them up to the Pig King, I’ll put on a live dismemberment show! Their death throes as they’re burned in the fires of hell will be a tribute to Filolial-sama, who has passed away!
“Motoyasu, hold him back! He’s trying to go somewhere—where is he trying to go?!”
Just as I couldn’t stand it anymore and was about to bolt, Father stopped me. Ugh… where am I supposed to vent this frustration?!

“Well, knowing those guys, I’d guess they’re hatching some plan to take down Naofumi or the Spear Hero. It’d be great if we could just ambush them as they stroll out, but things are looking pretty tough right now.”
“What a bunch of reckless fools… It’s practically like they’re walking up to the guillotine themselves.”
“Yes… even if they’ll stop at nothing, I think this move is definitely a bad one.”

Even the pandas are condemning the atrocities committed by the remnants of Takt. That’s right! Filolial-sama are angels! It’s absolutely unforgivable to humiliate those angels by reducing them to such a pitiful state.
“Naofumi… Sakura, Mel-chan, I’m worried…”
“Yeah, you’re right. Either way, first we have to resolve the issue with the Filolials who are causing trouble all over the world.”
Just then, a messenger ran up to us.

“Heroes! It’s an emergency! Someone posing as the Wise King of Wisdom has seized the capital of Shieldfreeden and the parliament building where the leadership is located, and is calling out the Shield Heroes and Spear Heroes by name to the entire world!”
“In a situation like this!?”
“The timing is spot-on…”
Is that Trash showing his face here of all places? But of all places, for a Trash who hates Demi-Humans to be in Shieldfreeden… It’s strange that he’s occupying a place like that.
I see… So does that mean that Trash came up with this plan? I’d forgiven him because he’d served under Father in the first world, but it seems he was my enemy all along.
“Either way, there’s a chance the Wise King of Wisdom might be there. In that case… I think we should go with the plan Motoyasu and Gaelion prepared… but where are those kids right now?”

“After making sure to level up the older brother properly and training him thoroughly, I entrusted both siblings to the Queen in Melromarc. The Queen is doing everything she can to protect them, just in case the King returns at any time.”
“So, either way, should we go to Melromarc to report?”
“Since word has spread that the Wise King of Wisdom is in Melromarc, it’s the perfect time to talk to them. We should leave as soon as possible.”

“Yeah. But there’s something we need to take care of before we leave, right? Motoyasu, let’s send the Filolials we’ve raised to countries all over the world. If the righteous Filolials are running around trying to protect everyone, we have to do our part too—no, wait… Yuki-chan and the others are already in various countries…”
“There’s no need to worry about that.”
Yuki-chan answers, shaking her hair as she speaks.
“Regarding the problem of Filolials running amok in various places, I hear Filolial-sama, the current Filolial Queen, has ordered all Filolials worldwide to quell the disturbances.”
“Can she really do that?”
“It wouldn’t be surprising if she could. That Queen may be a carefree fool, but when it comes to Filolials, she has a strong sense of responsibility.”
Rival starts making fun of the great Filolial-sama here.
“She has explicitly stated that, as a last resort, she’ll carry out the suppression while keeping the simultaneous shutdown of all Filolials worldwide in mind. It’s all about timing, isn’t it?”
“…It’s in the legends. The reason Filolials are said to be sacred beings is that when the world is overrun with Filolials who have turned to evil… the Filolials become incapacitated…”
At this point, the representative of the Shusaku clan explains the situation together with the elder of the Genmu clan.
“Wait, is there really a story like that?”

“In the history of the past… it is said that every single Filolial raised as a subordinate of the Demon King was subdued by the power of the Divine Bird… Considering how the Filolials raised by the Heroes had their movements sealed, I suppose that makes sense.”
“What! That is truly proof that the Filolial-sama are angels!”
That’s precisely why Filolial-sama cannot be misused! They are truly righteous beings! That is what Filolial-sama are!
“Even if evil beings try to manipulate Filolial-sama at will to conquer the world, it simply won’t go their way! Long live the angels!　Long live Filolial-sama!”
I feel like my anger has subsided just a little.

“So, once this matter is resolved, we’ll capture Filolial-sama, free them from the shackles of evil modifications—which were imposed under the Demon King’s protection—and then, this time for sure, raise them as our allies!　Since they’re all over the world! We’ll be able to build a kingdom for Filolial-sama!”
We’ll be able to secure Filolial-samas on a scale that surpasses even the first world! Filolial-samas all over the world! Please stay safe! We’ll definitely solve this problem!
“I wonder how we’ll handle food costs… I wonder if we can manage it with the bio-plant…”
“To say they can’t conquer the world as minions of evil… well, I find that hard to believe… Don’t they look like they could conquer the world when you see them?”
“Lasa, shh! If you value your life, you’d better keep quiet.”
“Hmm… We must consult the Queen of the Filolials before that countless number of them grows even larger.”
The pandas are saying something, but I’m going to make this ambition a reality!
“A-anyway! To keep the Wise King in check, let’s stop by Melromarc. We can’t say for sure that there isn’t a commotion going on there!”
“Exactly! Even though we’re Rival for Filo-tan’s affections, if anything happened to my Finacée, I wouldn’t be able to show my face to Filo-tan.”
“Since we’re allied nations, why don’t we send some troops to lend a hand?”
“That’s right. Let’s ask the warriors of Siltvelt for their help, too. Lars-chan, bring your men along as well.”
“Got it.”
And so, before heading to Shieldfreeden, we used a portal to travel to Melromarc.
